messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large stocky four-legged mammal standing in side profile facing right, with the thick shaggy brown fur, head, legs and paws of a bear, a glossy dark brown two-part ridged beetle-like shell covering its entire back, and a single long dark curved horn rising from its forehead.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "large furry brown bear head with lighter tan muzzle", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body facing right"}, {"looks_like": "single long smooth dark brown horn curving up and back to a sharp point", "part": "horn", "where": "on the top of the forehead between the eyes"}, {"looks_like": "two small rounded furry brown ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head behind the horn"}, {"looks_like": "small dark brown eyes", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "large black bear-like nose at the end of a tan muzzle", "part": "nose", "where": "at the tip of the face"}, {"looks_like": "stocky muscular torso covered in long shaggy brown fur with lighter tan on the sides", "part": "body", "where": "extending from shoulders to hindquarters"}, {"looks_like": "four thick heavily furred brown bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry paws with long pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "short small furry brown stub", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown two-lobed ridged beetle elytra with a segmented lighter brown rim", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the entire back from shoulders to rump"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
